name: Azeroth Companion
title: Talent Forge Finale — Visual Trees, Private Background & Music
features: Enhanced source-backed talent search with verified spell icons on search entries, larger rank and talent comparison cards, native tree highlights and reversible Focus Tree controls.
Private GIF, MP4 or WebM background with local IndexedDB storage, visibility/contrast shade, blur and fit controls, disabled until a local file is chosen.
Local audio music player with uploads, playlist, volume, seek, Play/Pause, next/previous, shuffle and repeat, without a visualizer or external service integration.
Private media files never leave the browser; browser quotas, codecs and autoplay restrictions apply, especially on iPhone.
Existing class/spec/hero talent rank allocation, source metadata, build comparisons, undo, JSON backups, saved local drafts and battle.net Worker remain unchanged.
Four optimized frontend bundles retained with dedicated security, storage and desktop/mobile checks.
